target_customer: Startups through enterprises that need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and similar compliance, especially in AI, defense, fintech and healthcare
problem: Companies need security and compliance programs but cannot staff them internally, and GRC automation tools alone do not run the work.
business_model: Managed service plus software: forward-deployed engineers operate an AI platform, sold as a subscription program
product_category: AI security and compliance services (Agency Comply, Auditsuisse Assurance)

founders.name: Amir Tarighat
founders.background_notes: Described on the YC page as developer, cybersecurity expert and privacy advocate.

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating with GRC tools and security stacks and running audits is standard engineering plus domain expertise; the agentic layer came later than the batch.

defensibility.rationale: Services heavy and copyable by Vanta, Drata or MSSPs; the licensed CPA audit arm adds some regulatory position but dates from 2025 registry entries, not founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The compliance automation platforms stayed large and Agency chose to integrate with Vanta and Drata rather than compete head on; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Startups needed SOC 2 and similar attestations to close enterprise deals, which fueled compliance automation vendors around 2020 to 2022; Agency's own comparison page names Vanta, Drata and Secureframe as the market.

identity.voice_and_tone: Trust and assurance positioning, with claims of 1,000+ customers and SOC 2 Type II

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared with many unrelated Agency companies, including an agentic customer success firm and an AI agent tools firm, so funding and news searches mix companies up; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Agency is still active with about 50 people and claims over 1,000 customers, but no priced funding round, exit or independent coverage was found, so its trajectory cannot be explained from sources. It moved from compliance services toward an AI platform with a CPA audit arm, and its generic name makes it hard to distinguish in press.
notes: Funding unverified: an aggregator reports a 500K seed in March 2022 (likely YC's standard deal) and other aggregators merge figures from unrelated companies named Agency (a 20M Series A in November 2025 belongs to an agentic customer success company). None recorded as rounds. YC page says founded 2020. No dated competitor sources near W22 were found. Co-founder Tyler Carbone education not listed. A search suggested Agency was acquired by Klaviyo with a wind down in 2026, but that snippet most likely concerns a different company called Agency; not used. Auditsuisse Assurance AG registry entry dated 2025-05 from a search snippet.
